name: Buddhism
summary: A tradition originating with Siddhartha Gautama, organised at launch into the Theravada, Mahayana and Vajrayana vehicles.

founded.note: Anchored to the Buddha's teaching career; scholarly dating of his death centers on the 480s BCE

adherents.basis: Enumerated by Pew. 4.1% of world population; the only major group that shrank between 2010 and 2020.
